sources.authority: World Intellectual Property Organization

sources.permission_evidence: Terms reviewed 2026-10-24. WIPO's open-access policy generally licenses WIPO-owned online publications/content under CC BY 4.0 unless more restrictive terms apply, but expressly excludes third-party content. WIPO Lex includes national legal materials; item-level ownership and service-specific terms are not established here. Keep collection and commercial reuse unknown until rights for each record are confirmed.

sources.authority: International Labour Organization

sources.permission_evidence: Rights and permissions page reviewed 2026-10-24. ILO states that its own publications and datasets/metadata published on or after 2023-05-03 are generally CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise indicated; older publications do not automatically receive that licence, and third-party components require separate clearance. NATLEX-linked national legislation is not presumed to be ILO-owned content. Keep collection and commercial reuse unknown for legal-text copies until item-specific rights and service terms are confirmed.

sources.authority: Althakira wa al-Ma'rifa for Studies (الذاكرة والمعرفة للدراسات), self-described Egyptian registered company
material_types: Court of Cassation judgments and published principles
sources.access_status: public search and individual full-text pages located; site footer states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0); scope for underlying legal texts not independently confirmed
sources.permission_evidence: The public documents catalogue and an individual Court of Cassation judgment page both display the statement: محتوى الموقع منشور برخصة المشاع الإبداعي — نَسب المُصنَّف 4.0 (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0). The About page describes the operator as a company registered under Egyptian law and established in 2021. The site presents full text and metadata for judgments, laws and decisions. This is a site-level licence statement only; it has not been established whether it covers every underlying judgment, statutory text, third-party reproduction, editorial annotation, metadata field, or source-derived compilation, nor whether the operator holds rights sufficient to license all of those elements. No collection or commercial reuse permission is claimed.
sources.bulk_download_or_api: No public API or bulk-export facility established in this review; public search, section filters and pagination are visible. Do not crawl or bulk extract.
sources.required_next_action: Manually review the stated CC BY 4.0 licence and any record-level rights notices; sample provenance, completeness and citation metadata across each document section; compare selected judgments against official court records where accessible; determine whether the licence covers the site's transcriptions and underlying legal texts. Keep collection and commercial reuse unknown and do not bulk-ingest until the scope and chain of rights are clear. If the licence scope remains ambiguous, do not contact the source holder under the current project constraint; keep the site as a discovery/cross-reference source only.
